notes: This is a source-project and corpus descriptor, not a weights manifest.
The repository implements a statistical n-gram language model and small classical neural models; it does not currently provide a pretrained transformer LLM checkpoint.
Do not mark corpus material as training-ready until rights, provenance, quality, deduplication, and split checks are completed.
When checkpoints are produced, register each concrete checkpoint separately using the standard model artifact manifest and SHA-256 verification workflow.
